scientific_question: Does genetically ordered rare-allele information improve FLARE local-ancestry boundaries beyond a common-only corrector and a rare-load-only control?

baseline.prediction_support: the exact phased target marker grid and Voronoi genetic cells authenticated by M30

rare_universe.definition: minor allele with MAC>=2, MAF<0.01 and at least two FREQ carrier individuals
rare_universe.unsupported_in_REF_LAI: retain the FREQ-selected site and expose an explicit no-support mask

arms.F0: frozen FLARE haplotype posterior without a fitted corrector
arms.C: residual corrector using only FLARE probabilities and ordered common context
arms.L: C plus local diploid rare load without reference ancestry labels
arms.D: L plus ancestry-specific REF_LAI rare support; diploid target dose is shared across haplotypes
arms.H: phase-aware rare presence by target haplotype; simulation ceiling only
arms.DSHAM: D with complete diploid REF_LAI ancestry labels permuted
arms.HSHAM: H with complete diploid REF_LAI ancestry labels permuted

model.inner_cv: three deterministic folds grouped by complete diploid individual
model.hyperparameter_selection: performed independently inside the training root for every fitted real or sham arm

null.changed: mapping between REF_LAI individuals and ancestry labels
null.formal_resolution: if the real statistic exceeds all 32 shams, exact exploratory p=1/33; do not report a percentile-95 significance claim

decision.GO_NEW_ROOTS: D improves boundary F1 over F0, C and L in both directions, exceeds every DSHAM improvement, does not increase macro MAE or false transitions, and no ancestry worsens in both directions
decision.LOAD_ONLY: L improves but D does not improve over L
decision.PHASE_CEILING_ONLY: H passes its sham and guardrails while D does not
decision.TRADEOFF: boundary F1 improves but at least one prespecified guardrail fails
decision.STOP_LINEAR_ORDERED_RARE: neither D nor H shows replicated incremental benefit
decision.next_step_after_GO: generate prospectively frozen new simulation roots before CNN or any confirmatory claim

stop_rules: any input or code SHA-256 mismatch
marker, sample, phase, locus-order or root identity mismatch
any split separates haplotypes or loci from the same individual
any sham changes a quantity listed as fixed
ridge solve or simplex projection is non-finite
any VALID or TEST input is accessed
